question: In which part of India is the The Coromandel Coast located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eastern Coastal Plain**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **Coromandel Coast** is the name given to the **south-eastern** coast of the Indian subcontinent, which forms a major part of the **Eastern Coastal Plain**. It is situated between the **Eastern Ghats** and the **Bay of Bengal**.

• Geographically, it extends from the **False Divi Point** at the mouth of the **Krishna River** in the north to **Kanyakumari** at the southern tip of India. It primarily covers the coastal areas of the state of **Tamil Nadu**, the Union Territory of **Puducherry**, and parts of **Andhra Pradesh**.
